title: Reign of Phoroneus, first king of Argos
summary: Phoroneus, called by Pliny "the most ancient King of Greece", begins to reign.
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-19. The date comes from Clinton's estimate of 17 generations from Phoroneus to the fall of Troy. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-19: Phoroneus: 1753 B.C."
chronologies.note: Clinton's 570 years before the fall of Troy (± 16.7 years). CFAH-3 notes Castor dates Phoroneus to 1807 B.C.
